generatedFromSchema_doNotEdit.title: Beta Float Behavior
generatedFromSchema_doNotEdit.description: Allows the mob to stay afloat while swimming. Passengers will be kicked out the moment the mob's head goes underwater, which may not happen for tall mobs.

fields.title: Chance Per Tick To Float
fields.description: The chance per tick to cause an upward impulse.

fields.title: Sink With Passengers
fields.description: If true, the mob will keep sinking as long as it has passengers.

fields.title: Time Under Water To Dismount Passengers
fields.description: Time in seconds that a floating vehicles head can be underwater before it causes its passengers to dismount.
